It is an undoubtedly, the need of the contemporary era that the feelings of an Aam Aadmi should be projected globally, and now it has become a global demand also. Looking to the afore-said demand, we have conceived a venture to enter into Digital Media with the brand name Clipper28. Our targeted age group, encompasses to all those who are Eight Years onwards, and we are launching it on August 19, 2015. 
news area Website Policy 
‘Abhaya Bharathi Media and Entertainment Pvt. Ltd.’, is one of the leading startup digital media companies based at capital city of Raipur, state of Chhattisgarh. It has been officially registered with Directorate of Advertising and Visual Publicity (DAVP) ,New Delhi, Madhya Pradesh, Himachal Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh and Kerala states.
